_comment: Maps each question paper onto a phase and a Phase 2 domain.
'file' uses the exact filenames from the specification. 'aliases' lets the
same paper be dropped in under its short name instead; the seeder tries
'negative_marks' is 0 everywhere because every supplied paper states
'There is no negative marking'. Change it here to enable it.

exam.title: Ph.D. Entrance Examination 2026 - ODD Semester
exam.description: Two-phase entrance examination: Phase 1 Research Methodology (common to all candidates) followed by a Phase 2 domain paper.

domains.name: Computer Science

domains.name: Mathematics

domains.name: Life Sciences

domains.name: English

domains.name: Commerce & Management
domains.description: Financial management, accounting, banking, marketing, human resources, organisational behaviour and strategy

domains.name: Agronomy

domains.name: Entomology
